 Hawks' Jalen Johnson worries slowly diminishing as impact continues to climb 
 Atlanta knows their star forward will be just fine. By Zach Langley | Nov 19, 2026, 3:00 PM EST Share on Facebook Share on X Share on Reddit Copy Article Add us as a preferred source Atlanta Hawks forward Jalen Johnson (1) against New Orleans Pelicans at Smoothie King Center on Oct. 31, 2026. | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect Describing Jalen Johnson's first month of the new season as inconsistent would be an understatement. It's been impossible to tell exactly how impactful he's been.
--> Describing Jalen Johnson's first month of the new season as inconsistent would be an understatement. It's been impossible to tell exactly how impactful he's been.
 One night, he'll drop an efficient 30. Other nights, he'll barely reach double digits. He's shooting just 18% from three on a decently large sample size. The concerns are real .
--> One night, he'll drop an efficient 30. Other nights, he'll barely reach double digits. He's shooting just 18% from three on a decently large sample size. The concerns are real .
 The only way for a high-volume player to break out of a slump, though, is to break out of it. The production of a player of Johnson's caliber doesn't just fall off the face of the Earth. Tough stretches are inevitable.
--> The only way for a high-volume player to break out of a slump, though, is to break out of it. The production of a player of Johnson's caliber doesn't just fall off the face of the Earth. Tough stretches are inevitable.
 After an undeniably poor stretch of performances, Atlanta's top option seems to be slowly putting it all together.
--> After an undeniably poor stretch of performances, Atlanta's top option seems to be slowly putting it all together.
 He wasn't perfect against OKC, but it was a step in the right direction
--> He wasn't perfect against OKC, but it was a step in the right direction
 Johnson made a three!
--> Johnson made a three!
 He hadn't hit one since October. This was a big deal . He was just 1-6 from beyond the arc against the Thunder, but again, it was a clear step in the right direction. Atlanta will take anything they can get. He should be getting his percentages back to normal in no time.
--> He hadn't hit one since October. This was a big deal . He was just 1-6 from beyond the arc against the Thunder, but again, it was a clear step in the right direction. Atlanta will take anything they can get. He should be getting his percentages back to normal in no time.
 At least, that's what the Hawks hope.
--> At least, that's what the Hawks hope.
 His lone make from the outside was far from the only positive sign he showed during his recent performance.
--> His lone make from the outside was far from the only positive sign he showed during his recent performance.
 He got back to what helped his production in the first couple of weeks of the season. He wasted no time making his impact felt. During Atlanta's very first possession of the game, he got Aday Mara to bite on a pump fake before slamming it down on top of Isaiah Hartenstein.
--> He got back to what helped his production in the first couple of weeks of the season. He wasted no time making his impact felt. During Atlanta's very first possession of the game, he got Aday Mara to bite on a pump fake before slamming it down on top of Isaiah Hartenstein.
 The two seven-footers never stood a chance.
--> The two seven-footers never stood a chance.
 It was then, right after this possession, that Johnson knocked down his first November three. It only took him until the 19th.
--> It was then, right after this possession, that Johnson knocked down his first November three. It only took him until the 19th.
 He finished the night with a 16-point, 12-rebound, 11-assist triple-double - his second of the new season.
--> He finished the night with a 16-point, 12-rebound, 11-assist triple-double - his second of the new season.
 If Johnson keeps it up, Atlanta will be in a great spot
--> If Johnson keeps it up, Atlanta will be in a great spot
 Honestly, they're already in a quality position.
--> Honestly, they're already in a quality position.
 At 9-6, through 15 games, the Hawks are tied with the Miami Heat for fourth place in the Eastern Conference.
--> At 9-6, through 15 games, the Hawks are tied with the Miami Heat for fourth place in the Eastern Conference.
 The only reason the Heat are technically above the Hawks right now is their early-season win in State Farm Arena. The two squads will likely be fighting for that position all year.
--> The only reason the Heat are technically above the Hawks right now is their early-season win in State Farm Arena. The two squads will likely be fighting for that position all year.
 If Atlanta wants to create any separation from Miami, they'll need Johnson to step it up . As long as he continues his upward trajectory of late, he'll soon be back in full form.
--> If Atlanta wants to create any separation from Miami, they'll need Johnson to step it up . As long as he continues his upward trajectory of late, he'll soon be back in full form.
